description: Interact with the GitLab REST API: search projects, get project details, list issues and merge requests, and look up users. Supports self-hosted GitLab instances.

action.description: Action: search_projects, get_project, list_issues, list_mrs, get_user.

base_url.description: GitLab base URL (default: https://gitlab.com/api/v4). Set for self-hosted instances.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded namespace/project path.

state.description: Filter by state: opened, closed, merged.

name: gitlab_action
